cards.title: Residual Error and Censored Data (BLQ) Handling
cards.claim: Residual error models must be specified (e.g., additive, proportional, or combined). For logarithmically transformed data, additive error is often used. Below Limit of Quantification (BLQ) data requires specific handling; simple omission or imputation is not sufficient. Maximum Likelihood methods with censored data options (e.g., M3 method) use the cumulative distribution function for censored values and probability density for non-censored values, often reverting to Laplacian approximation.
limitations: Naive pooled or QRPEM engines may have different constraints
Residual error cannot be less than 0.001 in some software contexts
